title: Hanasato Minori — Soothed By Friendship〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: After school
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Class 1-A

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Our stream starts soon...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (I'm really happy that we decided to go with my “What's In Our Bags?!” idea, but I always feel nervous about leading our discussions...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Still, if I do well here, I'll be helping Airi and the others out a lot...!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Alright, let's do it...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Minori? What were you just mumbling to yourself...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh?! Shiho?! Kohane?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Uhh... We're doing a stream soon and I'm feeling kinda nervous...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But we're using my idea for it, so I was trying to psych myself up.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh, one you came up with...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wait, one of the ones we talked about during lunch the other day...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! The one about the contents of our bags!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Wow...! It's really happening?
That's great! I'm so happy for you, Minori!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Thanks! I'm really glad that I asked for your opinion about it, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Still... I'm supposed to lead today...
I'm so nervous...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Really? Have you never led in the past?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Well, I have a few times...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Okay. Then, it might be best not to focus on that so much.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: In my experience, the more you stress about a certain riff or part, the more mistakes you end up making. At least, that's what it's like with my band...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, I've been through something like that...
And there have been times where I focused too hard on that one part and ended up getting worse at parts I was doing well on...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yeah, I've experienced both of those things!
It happens to me a lot during dance practice...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: All the more reason you should focus more on having fun during your stream, you know?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, I'm sure it'll go great! I mean, your idea sounded like so much fun!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Shiho! Kohane...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Thank you both so much! I'm already starting to feel better!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe. I'll go in smiling with lots of energy like I usually do!

rows.Speaker: Shiho & Kohane
rows.Line:
Good.
Yeah!
song00004_off_f
song00004_off_f
Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Alright, let's reveal today's big segment!
It's called...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: “What's In Our Bags?!”

rows.Speaker: Shizuku, Airi & Haruka
rows.Line: Yay!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: As the title suggests, we're gonna show all of you guys what's in each of our bags♪

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<R-Really?! Are you sure?!>
<Cool! We get to see some of your personal lives!>
<My mind needs some time to process this...>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hehe. Sounds like you're all plenty excited about this!
It was actually Minori's idea.

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Way to go, Minoriiiii!>
<She totally gets us!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe... This idea came from me also wanting to know what's in everyone's bags!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: So, let's begin with... Haruka! Take it away!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Okay. In my bag...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Naturally, I have my textbooks and notebooks. Also, my pen case, handkerchief, tissues... As well as beauty care items, like my lip gloss and hand cream...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: The notebooks I use can be found just about anywhere, and I've introduced some of my beauty care items before...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: So, why don't I show some of what's inside my pen case?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Whoa! You guys hear that?!
This is so exciting...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Here we are...! These are the ballpoint and colored pens I use on a regular basis. And this one with the penguin character is my favorite.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
(Oh, that penguin pen...
Didn't Haruka receive that as a gift from one of her classmates...?)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, that's so adorable...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Isn't it? I received it as a birthday present, and for a while it sort of just sat inside my pen case since I'm afraid of having it get all worn out...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But lately I've been using it when I feel that I need some extra motivation.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I bet the person who gave it to you is going to jump for joy when they find out that you're actually using it!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I sure hope so.
I really need to let them know and thank them again sometime.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, I'm sure they'd appreciate it!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Alright, let's keep go-go-going!
Next, we have...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Thanks for tuning in, everyone!
How did you like what we did today?

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<It was nice to learn which book Shizuku's reading right now!>
<I kinda want to get some of the kitty stuff Airi has!>

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<You doodle a lot in your notebook, Minori.>
<Don't forget to actually study lol!>
<But they were really cute. I wanna see them again sometime.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, uh... I drew those to stay awake during class... I never imagined that other people would see them...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Sounds like everyone really enjoyed it.
Why don't we do this again sometime and introduce some of the things we couldn't get to today?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What?! Really?!

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Yeah! Awesome!>
<Please do this again!>
<Tell us where you got everything next time!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Thank goodness. They genuinely enjoyed it...!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
(Shiho! Kohane!
I did it!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Anyway, we'll see you next time!
Bye bye!
